response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 13+ years across web, backend, mobile and embedded work, a CS degree, and genuine high-throughput experience at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby. However, the resume shows almost no evidence of the core requirements for this role: experimentation frameworks, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics platforms, statistical analysis, or bias/rollout-risk management. His experience is largely in small to mid-size startups rather than enterprise-scale, multi-region, cross-org platform work, and there is no demonstrated record of Principal-level influence across multiple teams or of translating business goals into measured growth outcomes. He could be a strong senior/staff hire elsewhere, but is a weak match for an IC6 growth/experimentation systems role.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on engineering across many languages and stacks, with CS degree
Low-latency, high-volume microservices experience (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering-craft signals: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and workshops
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flag or growth-measurement experience
Little evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure or statistical/data analysis depth
Scope and title trajectory (senior/staff at small firms) below Principal/IC6 cross-org expectations

key_factors.factor: Breadth and longevity of hands-on engineering experience
